///- --package . --timeout 2400000
open xml_codec

prototype to_text t : t -> string

inl text_node forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : t) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element name [] (xml.text_children (to_text v))

inl optional_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : option t) : list xml.xml_node =
    xml.option_list (optionm.map (text_node name) v)

inl repeated_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (vs : list t) : list xml.xml_node =
    listm.map (text_node name) vs

let rec x_gst_invoice_of_children
    (attributes : list (string * string)) (children : list xml.xml_node)
    : result (x_gst_invoice) (list xml_codec.decode_error)
    =
    inl errors = []
    inl o_version, errors =
        xml_codec.read_required "Version" (xml_codec.read_value x_gst_invoice_version_of_string) children errors
    inl v_irn, errors = xml_codec.read_optional "Irn" (xml_codec.read_value x_gst_invoice_irn_of_string) children errors
    inl o_tran_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_required "TranDtls" x_gst_invoice_tran_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl o_doc_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_required "DocDtls" x_gst_invoice_doc_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl o_seller_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_required "SellerDtls" x_gst_invoice_seller_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl o_buyer_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_required "BuyerDtls" x_gst_invoice_buyer_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl v_disp_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_optional "DispDtls" x_gst_invoice_disp_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl v_ship_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_optional "ShipDtls" x_gst_invoice_ship_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl v_item_list, errors = xml_codec.read_repeated "ItemList" x_gst_invoice_item_list_of_xml children errors
    inl o_val_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_required "ValDtls" x_gst_invoice_val_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl v_pay_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_optional "PayDtls" x_gst_invoice_pay_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl v_ref_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_optional "RefDtls" x_gst_invoice_ref_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl v_addl_doc_dtls, errors =
        xml_codec.read_repeated "AddlDocDtls" x_gst_invoice_addl_doc_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl v_exp_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_optional "ExpDtls" x_gst_invoice_exp_dtls_of_xml children errors
    inl v_ewb_dtls, errors = xml_codec.read_optional "EwbDtls" x_gst_invoice_ewb_dtls_of_xml children errors
    xml_codec.decoded_by errors fun () =>
        x_gst_invoice {
            version = xml_codec.present o_version
            irn = v_irn
            tran_dtls = xml_codec.present o_tran_dtls
            doc_dtls = xml_codec.present o_doc_dtls
            seller_dtls = xml_codec.present o_seller_dtls
            buyer_dtls = xml_codec.present o_buyer_dtls
            disp_dtls = v_disp_dtls
            ship_dtls = v_ship_dtls
            item_list = v_item_list
            val_dtls = xml_codec.present o_val_dtls
            pay_dtls = v_pay_dtls
            ref_dtls = v_ref_dtls
            addl_doc_dtls = v_addl_doc_dtls
            exp_dtls = v_exp_dtls
            ewb_dtls = v_ewb_dtls
        }

and let x_gst_invoice_of_xml (c : xml.xml_node) : result (x_gst_invoice) (list xml_codec.decode_error) =
    x_gst_invoice_of_children (xml.element_attributes c) (xml.element_children c)

and let x_gst_invoice_children (x : x_gst_invoice) : list xml.xml_node =
    inl nodes forall r. (f : x_gst_invoice_field r) (v : r) : list xml.xml_node =
        match f with
        | GstInvoice_field_Version => [ text_node "Version" v ]
        | GstInvoice_field_Irn => optional_text_nodes "Irn" v
        | GstInvoice_field_TranDtls => [ x_gst_invoice_tran_dtls_to_xml "TranDtls" v ]
        | GstInvoice_field_DocDtls => [ x_gst_invoice_doc_dtls_to_xml "DocDtls" v ]
        | GstInvoice_field_SellerDtls => [ x_gst_invoice_seller_dtls_to_xml "SellerDtls" v ]
        | GstInvoice_field_BuyerDtls => [ x_gst_invoice_buyer_dtls_to_xml "BuyerDtls" v ]
        | GstInvoice_field_DispDtls =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_gst_invoice_disp_dtls_to_xml "DispDtls" v) v)
        | GstInvoice_field_ShipDtls =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_gst_invoice_ship_dtls_to_xml "ShipDtls" v) v)
        | GstInvoice_field_ItemList => listm.map (fun v => x_gst_invoice_item_list_to_xml "ItemList" v) v
        | GstInvoice_field_ValDtls => [ x_gst_invoice_val_dtls_to_xml "ValDtls" v ]
        | GstInvoice_field_PayDtls =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_gst_invoice_pay_dtls_to_xml "PayDtls" v) v)
        | GstInvoice_field_RefDtls =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_gst_invoice_ref_dtls_to_xml "RefDtls" v) v)
        | GstInvoice_field_AddlDocDtls => listm.map (fun v => x_gst_invoice_addl_doc_dtls_to_xml "AddlDocDtls" v) v
        | GstInvoice_field_ExpDtls =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_gst_invoice_exp_dtls_to_xml "ExpDtls" v) v)
        | GstInvoice_field_EwbDtls =>
            xml.option_list (optionm.map (fun v => x_gst_invoice_ewb_dtls_to_xml "EwbDtls" v) v)
    inl rec walk (fields : list (exists r. x_gst_invoice_field r)) : list xml.xml_node =
        match fields with
        | packed :: rest =>
            inl exists r. f = packed
            listm.append (nodes f (x_gst_invoice_get f x)) (walk rest)
        | [] => []
    walk [
        exists GstInvoice_field_Version
        exists GstInvoice_field_Irn
        exists GstInvoice_field_TranDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_DocDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_SellerDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_BuyerDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_DispDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_ShipDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_ItemList
        exists GstInvoice_field_ValDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_PayDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_RefDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_AddlDocDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_ExpDtls
        exists GstInvoice_field_EwbDtls
    ]

and let x_gst_invoice_attributes (x : x_gst_invoice) : list (string * string) = []

and let x_gst_invoice_to_xml (name : string) (x : x_gst_invoice) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element name (x_gst_invoice_attributes x) (x_gst_invoice_children x)

generated_in_gst_inv01_1_1_writes_its_example (test)

test generated_in_gst_inv01_1_1_writes_its_example: passed 
///- --test
///> rust

inl example = x_gst_invoice_example 0i32
inl document = xml.element "GstInvoice" (x_gst_invoice_attributes example) (x_gst_invoice_children example)
inl schema = file_system.read_all_text (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "../deps/corpus/in/gst/inv01_1.1.json")
inl text = json_schema.json_document_text schema document
file_system.directory_create_all (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "") |> ignore
file_system.write_all_text (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "generated_in_gst_inv01_1_1_example.json") text
match json_schema.json_document "GstInvoice" text with
| node :: [] =>
    inl again =
        json_schema.json_document_text schema (x_gst_invoice_to_xml "GstInvoice" (xml_codec.expect_decoded (
            x_gst_invoice_of_xml node)))
    if again <> text then failwith "the JSON example round-trips through the typed reader and writer"
| _ => failwith "one root"
0

generated_in_gst_inv01_1_1_reads_its_documents (test)

test generated_in_gst_inv01_1_1_reads_its_documents: passed 
///- --test
///> rust

inl schema = file_system.read_all_text (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path "../deps/corpus/in/gst/inv01_1.1.json")
inl documents = [ "deps/corpus/in/gst/examples/irn-request-example.json" ]
inl check (path : string) : list string =
    inl text = file_system.read_all_text (generated_fiscal_runtime.sample_path (sm'.(++#) "../" path))
    match json_schema.json_document "GstInvoice" text with
    | node :: [] =>
        inl expected = json_schema.json_document_text schema node
        inl again =
            json_schema.json_document_text schema (x_gst_invoice_to_xml "GstInvoice" (xml_codec.expect_decoded (
                x_gst_invoice_of_xml node)))
        if again = expected then [] else
            [ sm'.(++#) path ": the typed reader does not keep every member" ]
    | _ => [ sm'.(++#) path ": not one root" ]
inl failures = listm.concat (listm.map check documents)
inl _ =
    match failures with
    | first :: _ =>
        inl count = sm'.obj_to_string (listm.length failures : i32)
        inl message = sm'.(++#) " real documents do not read back unchanged; first: " first
        failwith (sm'.(++#) count message)
    | [] => ()
0
